pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Canva Pro costs $18/month billed monthly, or $144/year if you pay annually… Canva Business costs $25/user/month or $250/user/year… The Free plan includes 50 Magic Studio AI credits per month, while Pro includes 500"

sources.title: Canva Pricing in 2026: Canva Pro Is $18/mo

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: 50 Magic Studio AI credits per month, 5 GB storage

plans.name: Pro
plans.quota: 500 AI credits per month, background remover, brand kit

nl.tagline: Alles-in-één ontwerptool met AI (Magic Studio) en templates
nl.description: Canva maakt ontwerpen voor social media, presentaties, video's, drukwerk en meer met duizenden templates en AI-functies zoals beeldgeneratie, achtergrond verwijderen en automatisch aanpassen van formaten. Ook in het Nederlands te gebruiken.
bestFor: Social visuals en presentaties in huisstijl
Teams die snel veel formaten nodig hebben
limitations: AI-functies begrensd via credits per maand

en.tagline: All-in-one design tool with AI (Magic Studio) and templates
en.description: Canva creates designs for social media, presentations, video, print and more with thousands of templates and AI features such as image generation, background removal and automatic resizing.
notFor: Professional photo editing or complex illustration
limitations: AI features capped by monthly credits
